nodes.description: Constant address that is the only account allowed to call start(); used by the only() modifier for privileged state initialisation.
Constant team wallet address required in the CLOSED branch of the fallback to sweep remaining tokens.
External ERC20_Transferable contract instance at a fixed address; target of balanceOf/transfer external calls.
Constant unix timestamp at which tokens unlock; compared against block.timestamp in _state and the countdown helper.
Constant deadline (LOCK_RELASE_TIME + 10 minutes) after which the faucet is CLOSED.
Array of participant addresses; pushed to during INIT and used as the divisor base for payouts in WITHDRAWAL.
Timestamp set once by start(); zero means the faucet is still in INIT.
Cached per-participant payout share computed from the token balance on first WITHDRAWAL call.
Human readable state labels indexed by the numeric state returned from _state().
Externally callable privileged function guarded by only(MULTISIG_OWNER) and inState(INIT) that records locked_since.
Payable fallback that refunds msg.value, collects participant addresses, distributes tokens and sweeps leftovers; main attack surface.
Internal view of the current state derived from locked_since and block.timestamp comparisons.
Public constant accessor returning the string label of the current state.
Internal linear search over team_accounts returning the index or -1; used for membership checks.
External constant getter returning the full team_accounts array.
External constant helper computing the remaining days/hours/minutes until LOCK_RELASE_TIME using block.timestamp.
Caller supplied by the transaction; used as recipient, membership key and access-control subject throughout the fallback.
The 'now' value, miner influenced, driving every state transition and the unlock countdown.
External value transfer msg.sender.transfer(msg.value) executed before state logic; classic reentrancy vector.
External ERC20 transfer call sending the computed share to msg.sender during WITHDRAWAL.
External ERC20 balanceOf call used to derive the distribution amount and the residual sweep amount.
Unsigned arithmetic amount_to_distribute / team_accounts.length performed without guards.
Storage array parameter scanned by indexOf().
Address parameter compared against each stored team entry inside indexOf().
Loop counter iterating over the team account array in indexOf().
Snapshot of _state() used to branch the fallback logic.
Cached token balance read before the CLOSED-branch sweep transfer.
Difference between LOCK_RELASE_TIME and now inside the countdown helper.
Whole days remaining until unlock.
Remaining hours component of the unlock countdown.
Remaining minutes component of the unlock countdown.

edges.reason: start() is gated by the only(MULTISIG_OWNER) modifier, making MULTISIG_OWNER the sole privileged caller.
The CLOSED branch requires msg.sender == TEAM_WALLET before sweeping the remaining token balance.
msg.sender is the destination of the external value transfer executed before any state mutation.
An attacker-controlled recipient of msg.sender.transfer can re-enter the fallback before the payout accounting completes.
msg.sender is used as the membership key and branch selector in every fallback state.
The ERC20 token transfer in the WITHDRAWAL branch sends tokens to the untrusted msg.sender.
The external token contract state variable is the callee of an untrusted token transfer call.
A malicious token contract could re-enter the payable fallback during token.transfer, before amount/state variables settle.
The token instance is queried via balanceOf to determine distributable and residual amounts.
amount_to_distribute is the numerator of the unguarded integer division computing each payout share.
team_accounts.length is the divisor of the payout computation; any arithmetic misuse propagates here.
The value passed to token.transfer is derived from the stored amount_to_distribute variable.
indexOf iterates the team_accounts storage array to test membership.
The fallback pushes new addresses into team_accounts during the INIT state.
The fallback calls indexOf to validate the caller before collecting or paying out.
The fallback calls _state to decide which branch to execute.
block.timestamp (now) alone determines the INIT/LOCKED/WITHDRAWAL/CLOSED transitions, a miner-influenceable dependency.
The unlock countdown and the LOCK_RELASE_TIME comparison depend on the untrusted block.timestamp.
LOCK_RELASE_TIME is compared against now inside _state.
WITHDRAWAL_END_TIME is compared against now inside _state.
locked_since == 0 is the INIT test and the base of the state machine.
start() writes locked_since with the current timestamp.
The public state() accessor delegates to _state() for the numeric state value.
The inState(State.INIT) modifier on start() calls _state() to validate the current state.
The labels array is indexed by the state value returned from _state.
The addr parameter is compared against each stored team address inside indexOf.
The addrs storage parameter is the array being scanned by indexOf.
The local state snapshot steers the fallback branch selection.
The local balance variable holds the external balanceOf result consumed by the sweep transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The addrs storage parameter exists only as the array scanned by indexOf.
The addr parameter exists only as the lookup key compared inside indexOf.
The loop counter i exists only to iterate the array inside indexOf.
The local state snapshot exists only to branch the fallback logic.
The local balance variable holds the result of the external token balanceOf call.
The diff local exists only inside the countdown computation of timeToUnlockDDHHMM.
The dd local exists only as a return component of the countdown computation.
The hh local exists only as a return component of the countdown computation.
The mm local exists only as a return component of the countdown computation.
